modulation by virus of host translation
modulation of host translation by virus
viral perturbation of host cell mRNA translation

definition: A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts translation of mRNA into protein in its host. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host translation
